about: What the setup wizard downloads when a tool is missing (install-import B1). Each pin was read live on 2026-10-14; `from` says where its version and SHA-256 came from, and `teamId` is the Developer ID team that signs it (codesign -dv on the downloaded file). `floor` is the oldest version already on the Mac that the wizard reuses (null: any). Refresh the pins before a release; toolchain.test.ts checks the shape.

node.from: nodejs.org/dist/v24.22.0/SHASUMS256.txt, its signature checked against github.com/nodejs/release-keys; 24 (Krypton) is the active LTS line. Floor: the runtime needs Node 20 (cli/aos.js init).

uv.from: github.com/astral-sh/uv/releases/tag/0.13.1: the .sha256 file published beside each archive (equal to GitHub's asset digest). Floor: `uv tool install --python`, which graph-cmd.js runs, since 0.3.0.

ollama.from: github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.40.4: sha256sum.txt (equal to GitHub's asset digest); one universal app for both arches, notarized (spctl: Notarized Developer ID), LSMinimumSystemVersion 14.0. Floor: the first release whose notes name Qwen 3.5.

claude.from: downloads.claude.ai/claude-code-releases/2.1.292/manifest.json (the stable channel on 2026-10-14), the manifest the native installer (claude.ai/install.sh) checks before it runs `claude install`. Floor: any; Claude Code updates itself and aos init checks what it supports.

codex.from: github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.162.1: codex-package_SHA256SUMS, the file the standalone installer (scripts/install/install.sh) checks. Floor: any; aos init picks plugin or direct wiring by what the CLI supports.
